title: oxplow.review.accepted
description: A person accepted an effort's work. The envelope carries what the verdict is about and is kept: its subject is the effort (first), its task, and every claim left unverified and decision left inferred at the verdict (an acceptance that names any was forced).

effort.description: Id of the effort the verdict is about (`eff12`).

inferred.description: Inferred decisions unreviewed at the verdict.

deviated.description: Files changed outside the task's area.
